data.name: Label1.Text
data.value:
1. Students are required to wear the complete and official school uniform during regular school days.
2. The P.E. uniform must be worn only on scheduled Physical Education days.
3. Uniforms should be clean, neat, and properly fitted at all times.
4. Unauthorized modifications or alterations to the school uniform are not allowed.
5. School-issued ID and proper footwear must be worn together with the uniform inside the campus.
